issues.fix_suggestion: Add -S flag row: 'Smart case (insensitive unless uppercase) | rg -S Error'

Add -o row: 'Show only matched part | rg -o pattern'
Add --stats row: 'Show search statistics | rg --stats pattern'

issues.description: The -u flag doesn't explain three levels of unrestricted search
issues.should_be: | `-u/-uu/-uuu` | Search ignored files (levels: ignore rules, hidden files, binary files) | `rg -uuu pattern` |
issues.fix_suggestion: Clarify that -u has three levels: -u (ignore .gitignore), -uu (+ hidden files), -uuu (+ binary files)

issues.description: Context flags don't explain what the number means
issues.should_be: | `-A/-B/-C` | Show N lines after/before/around matches | `rg -C 3 pattern` |
issues.fix_suggestion: Add clarification that the number specifies how many context lines to show
